meta.name: Power Rangers Dino Fury
meta.description: When an army of powerful alien beings is unleashed on Earth threatening life as we know it, a brand-new team of Power Rangers, fueled by the prehistoric power of the dinosaurs, are recruited to deal with the threat.

videos.name: Destination Dinohenge
videos.overview: Reporter Amelia accompanies Ollie and his mom, Dr. Akana, to investigate the mysterious Dinohenge statues; the trio run into an evil warrior named Void Knight and a threat that puts the entire world in danger.
videos.description: Reporter Amelia accompanies Ollie and his mom, Dr. Akana, to investigate the mysterious Dinohenge statues; the trio run into an evil warrior named Void Knight and a threat that puts the entire world in danger.

videos.name: Sporix Unleashed
videos.overview: Ollie carries out a plan to catch Sporix without his teammates' knowledge; Ollie realizes the benefit of working as a team.
videos.description: Ollie carries out a plan to catch Sporix without his teammates' knowledge; Ollie realizes the benefit of working as a team.

videos.name: Lost Signal
videos.overview: The Rangers intercept a mysterious message from outer space and Zayto is desperate to know if it was sent from his home planet; unable to decipher the message and losing hope, Zayto remembers another important message from the past.
videos.description: The Rangers intercept a mysterious message from outer space and Zayto is desperate to know if it was sent from his home planet; unable to decipher the message and losing hope, Zayto remembers another important message from the past.

videos.name: New Recruits
videos.overview: General Boomtower tries to steal a mysterious orb from the city museum; when the Rangers struggle to stop him, they get help from an unexpected source.
videos.description: General Boomtower tries to steal a mysterious orb from the city museum; when the Rangers struggle to stop him, they get help from an unexpected source.

videos.name: Winning Attitude
videos.overview: Izzy is determined to win a big race with the help of her Special Olympics athlete cousin, Lily; after Lily misses a training session and Izzy rejects more help, her sportsmanship is put to the test.
videos.description: Izzy is determined to win a big race with the help of her Special Olympics athlete cousin, Lily; after Lily misses a training session and Izzy rejects more help, her sportsmanship is put to the test.

videos.name: Stego Search
videos.overview: The Warden takes away Javi's keytar, putting him in a bad mood, which he refuses to explain to the team. Javi is forced to open up about his problems in order to find his Zord.
